title: Grandmother with Twin Girls, Driveway Car - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A warm post-World War II family snapshot depicting a smiling grandmother wearing spectacles and a floral short-sleeved dress, standing with her hands tenderly placed on the shoulders of two young girls in matching light-colored smocked dresses with ribbon hair bows. The trio is posed outdoors in a residential driveway directly in front of the rounded trunk and chrome bumper of a late 1940s automobile, featuring a dealer frame and a 1947 license plate.
